evidence.note: Title '12 Cross-town and 14 Cross-town fell 14 and 11 points while the network fell 5' matches punctuality.md (-14.2, -11.1; network 86.2% to 81.0%).
Bar labels 86/81, 85/70, 85/74, 87/87 and the 90% target line match the dashboard figures rounded to whole percentages, as the reader note says.

'Routes 12 and 14 Cross-town account for almost all of the network's fall' is an attribution the source never makes; it gives no route departure shares or contribution split, only that the other six routes each moved within 2 points.
'The other six routes' median moved by under 1 point' matches the source (87.4% to 87.0%, -0.4).

rationale: The figures, title and notes are faithful to punctuality.md. But the Insight states as fact that routes 12 and 14 account for 'almost all' of the network's fall, a contribution claim the source does not support: it has no route weights, and the other six routes could have fallen by up to 2 points each. That is a certainty beyond the source, which is the fail descriptor.
